jobs.title: Nunavut Housing Corporation - Vice President, Finance and Corporate Services
jobs.description:
About Nunavut Housing Corporation

The Nunavut Housing Corporation (NHC) is an arm’s-length public agency of the Government of Nunavut (GN) and the driving force in housing policy, program delivery, and construction across Nunavut’s 25 communities. With an operating budget of more than $230 million and a capital budget of approximately $171 million, NHC is leading Nunavut 3000, an estimated $1.6 billion plan to build 3,000 new homes over 10 years.

About the Role

Reporting to the President & CEO and serving on the Corporate Executive Committee, the VP, Finance and Corporate Services leads finance, human resources, IT, and policy and strategic planning, with five direct reports and functional oversight for approximately 350 employees across 25 Local Housing Organizations (LHOs). The VP also serves as President & CEO as required.

Key Responsibilities

Financial leadership:
Steward NHC’s financial health, advise the executive team, and represent NHC with the GN, CMHC, Cabinet, the Financial Management Board, and the Legislature.
People and culture:
Lead a newly established HR function and build a strong workforce, with a deliberate focus on Inuit employment, training, and development.
Technology:
Oversee the systems and IT services that support NHC and all 25 LHOs, strengthening digital capacity and data security for growth.
Policy and strategy:
Shape NHC’s policies, plans, and research, and support the Minister’s office.

What We’re Looking For

A dynamic, transformational leader
who will modernize and integrate corporate services, simplifying processes and raising performance as NHC grows.
Hands-on and ready to act,
making an immediate impact by strengthening the finance function and building depth across the team.
An innovative, steady executive
who brings fresh approaches to partnerships, funding, and procurement, and leads with confidence through change.
A coach and people builder
who develops talent, especially Nunavut Inuit, and communicates complex issues clearly and respectfully.

Qualifications

CPA designation and at least 10 years of progressive senior finance and management experience, ideally in the public sector, a Crown corporation, or housing.
Strong command of public-sector budgeting, financial administration, and audit.
Knowledge of Nunavut, the Nunavut Agreement, and the roles of Inuit organizations.
Housing experience and fluency in more than one of Nunavut’s official languages are assets; an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Priority will be given to Nunavut Inuit who self-identify as being enrolled under the Nunavut Agreement, in accordance with the GN Priority Hiring Policy.

Salary: $160,374 to $229,106 per year, plus Northern Allowance and subsidized housing.

Closing date: November 25, 2026

This position is a Position of Trust, a criminal record check required. AI will not be used in candidate screening.

To apply, submit your application to Phelps by clicking: https://phelpsgroup.ca/careers/31837/nunavut-housing-corporation-vp-finance-corp-services/apply/

jobs.title: IT Operations & Platform Director
jobs.description:
A propos de l'équipe

L’équipe TI et Transformation des Affaires
est une fonction mondiale relevant directement du PDG de Graitec. Elle est composée de quatre équipes : Transformation des Affaires, Données et IA, Sécurité de l’Information, et Opérations TI et Plateformes
. Ensemble, nous assurons les capacités opérationnelles qui permettent à Graitec de fonctionner efficacement et nous accompagnons sa transformation continue.

Nous travaillons en équipes fusionnées
, où les expert(e)s des affaires et des technologies collaborent autour d’objectifs communs et de résultats concrets.
L’équipe Opérations TI et Plateformes
soutient quotidiennement l’ensemble de l’organisation : plateformes d’affaires, infrastructure infonuagique, environnement numérique de travail et soutien aux utilisateurs. Son périmètre couvre notamment Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations
, Dynamics 365 CRM
, les outils de services professionnels, les systèmes RH, les plateformes clients et web, le centre de services TI, Microsoft Azure
, les réseaux et la gestion des identités. L’équipe dessert l’EMEA et l’Amérique du Nord et s’organise autour des domaines d’affaires qu’elle soutient.

Raison d’être du poste et contribution à la valeur d’affaires

Ce poste de direction est responsable de tout ce sur quoi les employés et les clients de Graitec comptent pour accomplir leur travail : les applications d’entreprise, l’infrastructure infonuagique et numérique ainsi que l’expérience globale de service TI.

Vous serez responsable de la qualité des services, de la fiabilité des plateformes, de la maîtrise des coûts et de la capacité de livraison. Plus qu’une fonction de soutien, vous agirez comme un partenaire stratégique auprès des équipes d’affaires, en bâtissant un environnement technologique agile, optimisé par l’IA et capable d’évoluer avec la croissance de l’entreprise.

Votre succès sera mesuré selon des indicateurs d’affaires tels que :

La productivité et l’expérience des employés;
La disponibilité, la performance et la résilience des plateformes;
L’optimisation des coûts opérationnels;
Les gains d’efficacité et d’échelle.

Ce que le succès représente dans les 12 premiers mois
Déployer un centre de services TI mondial axé sur l’expérience client, avec des niveaux de service publiés, un catalogue de services complet et des options libre-service largement adoptées. Les indicateurs de satisfaction (CSAT) et de recommandation (NPS) sont mesurés et en amélioration.
Assurer le soutien opérationnel complet du programme Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations
, avec un modèle d’exploitation et de soutien défini avant chaque mise en production.
Consolider l’environnement infonuagique et automatiser de bout en bout le cycle de vie des employés (arrivées, mobilités internes et départs).
Fournir une vision consolidée et fiable des coûts de plateformes, du positionnement des licences et de la performance des fournisseurs, tout en générant des économies.
Structurer les équipes comme une seule fonction intégrée, avec une taille optimale et une réduction des dépendances critiques.
Mettre en production une première vague d’initiatives d’IA et d’automatisation permettant de réduire les interventions manuelles et le volume de billets.
Renforcer la résilience opérationnelle grâce à des mécanismes éprouvés de sauvegarde et de relève informatique.

Responsabilités principales

Plateformes d’entreprise
Assurer la gestion complète du cycle de vie des plateformes d’entreprise : Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, CRM, solutions d’automatisation des services professionnels, systèmes RH et de paie ainsi que plateformes clients et web.
Collaborer avec l’équipe Transformation des Affaires pour assurer une transition harmonieuse des projets vers les opérations.
Travailler avec l’équipe Données et IA afin de garantir la qualité et la fiabilité des données.
Gérer les plateformes comme des produits : responsables identifiés, adoption mesurée et feuille de route alignée sur la valeur d’affaires.

Excellence des services TI
Développer une expérience de services TI mondiale alignée sur les meilleures pratiques ITIL et centrée sur l’utilisateur.
Définir et publier les niveaux de service et le catalogue de services.
Superviser la gestion des incidents, des problèmes et des changements à l’aide d’une plateforme ITSM moderne.
Assurer la gestion de l’environnement numérique de travail : Microsoft 365, Copilot, gestion des postes de travail et cycle de vie des employés.
Exploiter les données d’adoption et les commentaires des utilisateurs afin d’éliminer les causes récurrentes des demandes plutôt que de simplement les traiter.

IA et automatisation des opérations
Définir la stratégie d’intégration de l’IA au sein des opérations TI : résolution assistée ou automatisée, opérations auto-réparatrices et optimisation de l’environnement de travail numérique.
Collaborer avec les équipes Données et IA pour intégrer des solutions d’IA générant des bénéfices mesurables.
Mesurer et communiquer les gains obtenus : réduction des efforts manuels, diminution des délais de résolution et économies réalisées.

Infonuagique, infrastructure et résilience
Superviser les environnements Azure, les réseaux, la gestion des identités, les plateformes d’intégration et la modernisation des environnements existants.
Être responsable de la disponibilité, de la performance, de la sauvegarde, de la reprise après sinistre et de la résilience opérationnelle.
Promouvoir l’automatisation et l’infrastructure comme code afin de soutenir la croissance sans augmentation proportionnelle des effectifs.

Leadership et développement des équipes
Diriger et développer une équipe distribuée composée de gestionnaires d’infrastructure, de plateformes et de support.
Favoriser le développement des compétences, la relève et une culture d’imputabilité.
Accompagner les initiatives de gestion du changement pour assurer l’adoption des nouvelles façons de travailler.

Gestion des fournisseurs et des licences
Gérer les coûts des plateformes et de l’infrastructure, les licences et les relations avec les fournisseurs stratégiques.
Négocier les partenariats en fonction des résultats d’affaires recherchés.
Améliorer la transparence des coûts unitaires et démontrer les gains d’efficacité.
Construire les dossiers d’investissement pour les dépenses technologiques majeures et mesurer les bénéfices obtenus.

Sécurité de l’information et intégration d’acquisitions
Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe Sécurité de l’Information afin d’intégrer les contrôles de sécurité, la gestion des accès, la conformité et les audits.
Soutenir les certifications telles que SOC 2 et ISO 27001.
Diriger l’intégration TI des acquisitions, de la préparation initiale à l’intégration complète dans l’architecture de l’entreprise.

Profil recherché

Expérience requise
Expérience significative à un poste de direction dans les opérations TI et la gestion d’applications d’entreprise dans un environnement international.
Expertise approfondie de l’écosystème Microsoft : Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Dynamics 365 CRM, Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID et gestion moderne des postes de travail.
Expérience démontrée dans la mise en place de services TI orientés client et hautement performants.
Participation à des programmes majeurs de modernisation ERP et transition vers les opérations courantes.
Solide expérience de gestion des coûts, des licences, des fournisseurs et de l’intégration TI lors d’acquisitions.
Réalisations concrètes en matière d’IA et d’automatisation à grande échelle.
Capacité à interagir avec les équipes de direction et à présenter clairement les coûts, les risques, les bénéfices et le retour sur investissement.
Leadership calme et efficace en situation de crise ou lors d’incidents majeurs.

Atouts
Certification ITIL v4, TOGAF ou équivalent.
Certification PMP, PgMP ou équivalent.
Expérience dans un environnement multisociété et multinational.
Expérience au sein d’une entreprise en forte croissance, active en acquisition ou soutenue par du capital-investissement.

Processus d'entretien

Diversité et inclusion

Chez Graitec
, nous sommes fiers de promouvoir un milieu de travail inclusif où chacun peut être authentique et contribuer pleinement à notre succès. Nous accueillons les candidatures de toutes origines et évaluons chaque personne uniquement en fonction de ses compétences, de son expérience et de sa capacité à réussir dans le rôle.
Graitec utilise l’intelligence artificielle pour soutenir certains processus internes. Toutefois, toutes les décisions liées au recrutement, à l’évaluation des candidatures et à l’embauche sont prises exclusivement par notre équipe Acquisition de talents et nos gestionnaires recruteurs.
Processus de recrutement
Candidature
: Soumettez votre CV via le site Carrières de Graitec.
Entrevue RH
: Discussion exploratoire pour mieux vous connaître.
Entrevue avec le gestionnaire recruteur
: Échange approfondi sur le poste et votre expérience.
Entrevue avec des pairs ou partenaires d’affaires
: Peut inclure une présentation ou un exercice collaboratif.
Entrevue finale
: Rencontre avec le dirigeant de l’unité d’affaires.

Rémunération

Rémunération cible (OTE)

80 % salaire de base + 20 % rémunération variable

OTE minimum : 150 000 $ CAD

OTE maximum : 180 000 $ CAD

La fourchette salariale indiquée est présentée à titre informatif et correspond au niveau de séniorité visé pour ce poste.

jobs.title: Director, Advanced Planning (Tax and Estate Planning)
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

The Director, Advanced Planning (DAP) is accountable for providing advanced tax and estate planning solution advice to high net worth
end-clients through financial advisors; and for providing education to the financial advisors and internal audiences as a subject matter expert for new and existing tax efficient products and services.

As a tax and estate planning expert,
the DAP is also responsible for keeping the regional sales team current with their knowledge of tax and estate planning solutions. By partnering with the Regional Sales Director, the DAP will drive wealth and insurance product sales by providing Advisors with case consultation and support through the delivery of the best tax efficient insurance solutions for the Client, and solidify our partnership with Advisor and their firm.

What will you do?

Promote and deliver effective tax and estate planning (TEPG) advice to our sales team and key distribution partners
Deliver tax presentations to large audiences and promote sales tools that support Sun Life's products, proprietary financial planning concepts, and specialty needs analyses, including legal and compliance issues
Consult with High Net Worth Clients and their own allied professional (accountants and lawyers) to identify tax-planning opportunities related to their estate, wealth, business succession and business continuation planning
Develop a thorough understanding of the various Sun Life distribution channels by establishing and enhancing relationships
Consults in the creation and deployment of consumer/allied advisor reference materials
Delivers presentations and training workshops and associated materials for financial advisors.
Delivers client seminars and associated materials
Involvement in case development, including case research and special illustration
Participates in industry profile building activities
Keeps current, through research, on tax and estate planning issues

What do you need to succeed?

Strong knowledge of personal and corporate tax planning, including but not limited to tax planning areas such as retirement compensation arrangements, charitable gifting, wills and trusts, and the dynamics of business ownership and succession planning.
Experience with and comfortable working in the High Net Worth market.
Experience creating Powerpoint Presentations
Excellent presentation, facilitation and training skills
Excellent understanding of industry trends and their implication on achieving business sales results/objectives.
Strong knowledge of personal and corporate taxation
CA, CPA, LL.B or FCIA designation
Completion of the CICA In-depth Tax Program and the In-Depth Tax Issues for the Owner Manager Business course (considered an asset)
Strong organization and analytical skills
Strong interpersonal and influencing skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Minimum of 5 years’ of professional experience within the financial services industry.

What's in it for you?

Competitive salary and bonus structure influenced by market range data
Flexible Benefits from the day you join to meet the needs of you and your family
Pension, stock and savings programs to help build and enhance your future financial security
Wellness programs that support the three pillars of your health – mental, physical and financial
Fitness and wellness programs that help you balance work and life and enjoy a healthier lifestyle
Work-life balance by scheduling your day around your priorities and having more time to spend on the important things

Compensation:

This role includes an incentive plan and total compensation that could well exceed the salary range posted.

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Salary Range:

130,000/130 000 - 180,000/180 000

Job Category:

Sales - SIP

16/11/2026

jobs.title: Senior Director of Finance & Operations
jobs.description:
BoomerangFX

Location:
Mississauga, Ontario — on-site, five days per week
Reports to:
Chief Executive Officer

Mandatory Experience

A Canadian CPA designation and hands-on experience leading finance and operations for a PE-backed SaaS company scaling ARR from $5 million to $50 million are mandatory. Only applicants meeting these requirements will be considered for the role.

Why Join BoomerangFX?

BoomerangFX is a global healthcare technology company bringing SaaS, artificial intelligence and digital marketing together to help private-pay healthcare practices operate and grow. Recognized through Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500 program, we are building technology that simplifies practice management, strengthens patient engagement and helps healthcare businesses reach more people.
With operations in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia and India
, we are scaling internationally and working at the forefront of AI in healthcare. Our teams collaborate across countries and disciplines to turn new ideas into products and services that make a practical difference for customers.

Joining BoomerangFX is an opportunity to build your career alongside a growing global business. You will have meaningful responsibility, exposure to international markets and the opportunity to contribute ideas, develop your skills and see the impact of your work. We welcome people who take ownership, move quickly and want to help build what comes next.

The Role

Reporting to the CEO, you will lead financial management and general operations with strong financial acumen, commercial judgment and a practical approach to execution
.

You will oversee the Controller and Accountant
while taking responsibility for talent acquisition, human resources, vendor negotiations and corporate infrastructure
. You must be comfortable reviewing the detail, challenging assumptions and resolving issues personally while building an accountable team.

Financial Leadership and Accounting Oversight

Directly oversee the Controller and Accountant, setting clear expectations for accuracy, reporting deadlines, financial controls and accountability. Review their work and provide hands-on guidance on complex issues.
Own the quality and timeliness of monthly, quarterly and annual financial reporting. Review financial statements, balance-sheet reconciliations, management reports and material accounting judgments.
Oversee billing, subscription revenue recognition, deferred revenue, collections, accounts payable, payroll and intercompany reporting. Maintain clear controls over approvals, payments and financial records.
Coordinate external accountants, auditors and tax advisers, and strengthen accounting policies and controls as the company scales.

Financial Performance and Cash Management

Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, financial modelling and variance analysis. Challenge assumptions and translate financial results into clear recommendations for the CEO and department leaders.
Own a rolling 13-week cash-flow forecast and longer-term liquidity projections. Improve collections, working capital, spending discipline and visibility into financial commitments.
Analyze profitability by product, service and market. Use SaaS metrics, including ARR, retention, churn, gross margin, customer acquisition cost and payback, to evaluate performance and investment decisions.
Assess hiring plans, pricing, operating costs and major expenditures against expected returns. Drive measurable improvements in margins, productivity and progress toward sustainable profitability.

Talent Acquisition and Human Resources

Oversee talent acquisition and human resources, including internal staff and external providers. Align recruitment priorities and headcount plans with approved budgets and business needs.
Oversee recruitment execution, agency relationships, hiring timelines, onboarding and workforce planning. Hold hiring managers accountable for clear requirements, timely decisions and hiring outcomes.
Oversee HR administration, employee records, compensation and benefits coordination, performance-review processes, employee relations and offboarding, working with qualified advisers where required.

Vendor Negotiations and Corporate Infrastructure

Lead vendor negotiations and oversee procurement, contracts and renewals. Secure commercially sound pricing, payment terms and service commitments, and hold providers accountable for delivery.
Oversee corporate infrastructure, including offices, facilities, equipment, business systems and outsourced services. Ensure these resources support reliable daily operations and future growth.
Work with technology leaders on corporate IT providers, software licences, infrastructure spending and business continuity arrangements. Improve utilization and eliminate unnecessary or duplicate costs.

Operating Performance and Team Leadership

Establish operating KPIs, management dashboards and regular performance reviews across finance and the functions under your oversight.
Improve workflows, approval processes and reporting through practical automation and stronger data quality. Ensure corrective actions have accountable owners and deadlines.
Lead and develop the finance team and collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product and Technology leaders to improve execution and resource allocation.

Mandatory Qualifications

CPA designation in good standing in Canada.

At least 10 years of progressive finance experience, including hands-on leadership across financial reporting, controllership, budgeting, forecasting, cash management and operating performance.
At least three years of hands-on experience in a fast-paced SaaS business, including leadership of finance and operations for a PE-backed SaaS company scaling ARR from $5 million to $50 million.

Strong financial acumen and commercial judgment: the ability to interrogate financial results, build credible forecasts, evaluate SaaS unit economics and make sound decisions on costs, headcount and investment.
Proven experience directly supervising a Controller and accounting staff, reviewing their work and maintaining high standards for financial accuracy, control and delivery.
Direct experience overseeing talent acquisition, human resources, vendor negotiations and corporate infrastructure, with accountability for operational results.
Advanced financial modelling and Excel or Google Sheets skills, proficiency with accounting and reporting systems, and the ability to explain financial issues clearly to business leaders.
A record of personal ownership and effective execution in an environment with rapidly changing priorities, tight deadlines and limited resources. You must be willing to work on-site in Mississauga five days per week.

Additional Experience We Value

Measurable success improving profitability, cash generation or progress toward break-even.
Experience managing multiple entities, currencies or international operations.
Experience in healthcare technology or a business combining SaaS subscriptions and services.
Experience implementing finance systems, automating reporting or supporting transaction readiness.

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary:
CAD $135,000–$150,000 annually.
Annual target performance bonus:
50% of base salary, based on achievement of agreed performance objectives.
Total target compensation:
CAD $202,500–$225,000 annually.
Performance objectives will reflect measurable outcomes in profitability, cash management, financial reporting and operational execution.
Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage.
Paid vacation and free on-site parking.
An opportunity to work closely with the CEO and senior leadership and make a measurable contribution to a growing global healthcare technology business.

How to Apply

Submit your résumé with a brief summary of your experience in high-growth software or technology-enabled companies, including two or three measurable financial or operational results you personally delivered.
Shortlisted candidates should be prepared to discuss their experience with financial oversight, operational leadership, strategic planning, and board reporting. CPA credentials, employment experience, and professional references will be verified.

Accessibility Statement

BoomerangFX is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals and are dedicated to accommodating people with disabilities. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process, please contact recruitment@boomerangfx.com.

Déployer un centre de services TI mondial axé sur l’expérience client, avec des niveaux de service publiés, un catalogue de services complet et des options libre-service largement adoptées. Les indicateurs de satisfaction (CSAT) et de recommandation (NPS) sont mesurés et en amélioration.
Assurer le soutien opérationnel complet du programme Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations
, avec un modèle d’exploitation et de soutien défini avant chaque mise en production.
Consolider l’environnement infonuagique et automatiser de bout en bout le cycle de vie des employés (arrivées, mobilités internes et départs).
Fournir une vision consolidée et fiable des coûts de plateformes, du positionnement des licences et de la performance des fournisseurs, tout en générant des économies.
Structurer les équipes comme une seule fonction intégrée, avec une taille optimale et une réduction des dépendances critiques.
Mettre en production une première vague d’initiatives d’IA et d’automatisation permettant de réduire les interventions manuelles et le volume de billets.
Renforcer la résilience opérationnelle grâce à des mécanismes éprouvés de sauvegarde et de relève informatique.

Responsabilités principales

Plateformes d’entreprise
Assurer la gestion complète du cycle de vie des plateformes d’entreprise : Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, CRM, solutions d’automatisation des services professionnels, systèmes RH et de paie ainsi que plateformes clients et web.
Collaborer avec l’équipe Transformation des Affaires pour assurer une transition harmonieuse des projets vers les opérations.
Travailler avec l’équipe Données et IA afin de garantir la qualité et la fiabilité des données.
Gérer les plateformes comme des produits : responsables identifiés, adoption mesurée et feuille de route alignée sur la valeur d’affaires.

Excellence des services TI
Développer une expérience de services TI mondiale alignée sur les meilleures pratiques ITIL et centrée sur l’utilisateur.
Définir et publier les niveaux de service et le catalogue de services.
Superviser la gestion des incidents, des problèmes et des changements à l’aide d’une plateforme ITSM moderne.
Assurer la gestion de l’environnement numérique de travail : Microsoft 365, Copilot, gestion des postes de travail et cycle de vie des employés.
Exploiter les données d’adoption et les commentaires des utilisateurs afin d’éliminer les causes récurrentes des demandes plutôt que de simplement les traiter.

IA et automatisation des opérations
Définir la stratégie d’intégration de l’IA au sein des opérations TI : résolution assistée ou automatisée, opérations auto-réparatrices et optimisation de l’environnement de travail numérique.
Collaborer avec les équipes Données et IA pour intégrer des solutions d’IA générant des bénéfices mesurables.
Mesurer et communiquer les gains obtenus : réduction des efforts manuels, diminution des délais de résolution et économies réalisées.

Infonuagique, infrastructure et résilience
Superviser les environnements Azure, les réseaux, la gestion des identités, les plateformes d’intégration et la modernisation des environnements existants.
Être responsable de la disponibilité, de la performance, de la sauvegarde, de la reprise après sinistre et de la résilience opérationnelle.
Promouvoir l’automatisation et l’infrastructure comme code afin de soutenir la croissance sans augmentation proportionnelle des effectifs.

Leadership et développement des équipes
Diriger et développer une équipe distribuée composée de gestionnaires d’infrastructure, de plateformes et de support.
Favoriser le développement des compétences, la relève et une culture d’imputabilité.
Accompagner les initiatives de gestion du changement pour assurer l’adoption des nouvelles façons de travailler.

Gestion des fournisseurs et des licences
Gérer les coûts des plateformes et de l’infrastructure, les licences et les relations avec les fournisseurs stratégiques.
Négocier les partenariats en fonction des résultats d’affaires recherchés.
Améliorer la transparence des coûts unitaires et démontrer les gains d’efficacité.
Construire les dossiers d’investissement pour les dépenses technologiques majeures et mesurer les bénéfices obtenus.

Sécurité de l’information et intégration d’acquisitions
Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe Sécurité de l’Information afin d’intégrer les contrôles de sécurité, la gestion des accès, la conformité et les audits.
Soutenir les certifications telles que SOC 2 et ISO 27001.
Diriger l’intégration TI des acquisitions, de la préparation initiale à l’intégration complète dans l’architecture de l’entreprise.

Profil recherché

Expérience requise
Expérience significative à un poste de direction dans les opérations TI et la gestion d’applications d’entreprise dans un environnement international.
Expertise approfondie de l’écosystème Microsoft : Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Dynamics 365 CRM, Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID et gestion moderne des postes de travail.
Expérience démontrée dans la mise en place de services TI orientés client et hautement performants.
Participation à des programmes majeurs de modernisation ERP et transition vers les opérations courantes.
Solide expérience de gestion des coûts, des licences, des fournisseurs et de l’intégration TI lors d’acquisitions.
Réalisations concrètes en matière d’IA et d’automatisation à grande échelle.
Capacité à interagir avec les équipes de direction et à présenter clairement les coûts, les risques, les bénéfices et le retour sur investissement.
Leadership calme et efficace en situation de crise ou lors d’incidents majeurs.

Atouts
Certification ITIL v4, TOGAF ou équivalent.
Certification PMP, PgMP ou équivalent.
Expérience dans un environnement multisociété et multinational.
Expérience au sein d’une entreprise en forte croissance, active en acquisition ou soutenue par du capital-investissement.

Processus d'entretien

Diversité et inclusion

Chez Graitec
, nous sommes fiers de promouvoir un milieu de travail inclusif où chacun peut être authentique et contribuer pleinement à notre succès. Nous accueillons les candidatures de toutes origines et évaluons chaque personne uniquement en fonction de ses compétences, de son expérience et de sa capacité à réussir dans le rôle.
Graitec utilise l’intelligence artificielle pour soutenir certains processus internes. Toutefois, toutes les décisions liées au recrutement, à l’évaluation des candidatures et à l’embauche sont prises exclusivement par notre équipe Acquisition de talents et nos gestionnaires recruteurs.
Processus de recrutement
Candidature
: Soumettez votre CV via le site Carrières de Graitec.
Entrevue RH
: Discussion exploratoire pour mieux vous connaître.

: Échange approfondi sur le poste et votre expérience.
Entrevue avec des pairs ou partenaires d’affaires
: Peut inclure une présentation ou un exercice collaboratif.
Entrevue finale
: Rencontre avec le dirigeant de l’unité d’affaires.

Rémunération

OTE maximum : 180 000 $ CAD

new_jobs.title: Director, Advanced Planning (Tax and Estate Planning)
new_jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

The Director, Advanced Planning (DAP) is accountable for providing advanced tax and estate planning solution advice to high net worth
end-clients through financial advisors; and for providing education to the financial advisors and internal audiences as a subject matter expert for new and existing tax efficient products and services.

As a tax and estate planning expert,
the DAP is also responsible for keeping the regional sales team current with their knowledge of tax and estate planning solutions. By partnering with the Regional Sales Director, the DAP will drive wealth and insurance product sales by providing Advisors with case consultation and support through the delivery of the best tax efficient insurance solutions for the Client, and solidify our partnership with Advisor and their firm.

What will you do?

Promote and deliver effective tax and estate planning (TEPG) advice to our sales team and key distribution partners
Deliver tax presentations to large audiences and promote sales tools that support Sun Life's products, proprietary financial planning concepts, and specialty needs analyses, including legal and compliance issues
Consult with High Net Worth Clients and their own allied professional (accountants and lawyers) to identify tax-planning opportunities related to their estate, wealth, business succession and business continuation planning
Develop a thorough understanding of the various Sun Life distribution channels by establishing and enhancing relationships
Consults in the creation and deployment of consumer/allied advisor reference materials
Delivers presentations and training workshops and associated materials for financial advisors.
Delivers client seminars and associated materials
Involvement in case development, including case research and special illustration
Participates in industry profile building activities
Keeps current, through research, on tax and estate planning issues

What do you need to succeed?

Strong knowledge of personal and corporate tax planning, including but not limited to tax planning areas such as retirement compensation arrangements, charitable gifting, wills and trusts, and the dynamics of business ownership and succession planning.
Experience with and comfortable working in the High Net Worth market.
Experience creating Powerpoint Presentations
Excellent presentation, facilitation and training skills
Excellent understanding of industry trends and their implication on achieving business sales results/objectives.
Strong knowledge of personal and corporate taxation
CA, CPA, LL.B or FCIA designation
Completion of the CICA In-depth Tax Program and the In-Depth Tax Issues for the Owner Manager Business course (considered an asset)
Strong organization and analytical skills
Strong interpersonal and influencing skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Minimum of 5 years’ of professional experience within the financial services industry.

What's in it for you?

Competitive salary and bonus structure influenced by market range data
Flexible Benefits from the day you join to meet the needs of you and your family
Pension, stock and savings programs to help build and enhance your future financial security
Wellness programs that support the three pillars of your health – mental, physical and financial
Fitness and wellness programs that help you balance work and life and enjoy a healthier lifestyle
Work-life balance by scheduling your day around your priorities and having more time to spend on the important things

Compensation:

This role includes an incentive plan and total compensation that could well exceed the salary range posted.

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

new_jobs.title: Senior Director of Finance & Operations
new_jobs.description:
BoomerangFX

Location:
Mississauga, Ontario — on-site, five days per week
Reports to:
Chief Executive Officer

Mandatory Experience

A Canadian CPA designation and hands-on experience leading finance and operations for a PE-backed SaaS company scaling ARR from $5 million to $50 million are mandatory. Only applicants meeting these requirements will be considered for the role.

Why Join BoomerangFX?

BoomerangFX is a global healthcare technology company bringing SaaS, artificial intelligence and digital marketing together to help private-pay healthcare practices operate and grow. Recognized through Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500 program, we are building technology that simplifies practice management, strengthens patient engagement and helps healthcare businesses reach more people.
With operations in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia and India
, we are scaling internationally and working at the forefront of AI in healthcare. Our teams collaborate across countries and disciplines to turn new ideas into products and services that make a practical difference for customers.

Joining BoomerangFX is an opportunity to build your career alongside a growing global business. You will have meaningful responsibility, exposure to international markets and the opportunity to contribute ideas, develop your skills and see the impact of your work. We welcome people who take ownership, move quickly and want to help build what comes next.

The Role

Reporting to the CEO, you will lead financial management and general operations with strong financial acumen, commercial judgment and a practical approach to execution
.

You will oversee the Controller and Accountant
while taking responsibility for talent acquisition, human resources, vendor negotiations and corporate infrastructure
. You must be comfortable reviewing the detail, challenging assumptions and resolving issues personally while building an accountable team.

Financial Leadership and Accounting Oversight

Directly oversee the Controller and Accountant, setting clear expectations for accuracy, reporting deadlines, financial controls and accountability. Review their work and provide hands-on guidance on complex issues.
Own the quality and timeliness of monthly, quarterly and annual financial reporting. Review financial statements, balance-sheet reconciliations, management reports and material accounting judgments.
Oversee billing, subscription revenue recognition, deferred revenue, collections, accounts payable, payroll and intercompany reporting. Maintain clear controls over approvals, payments and financial records.
Coordinate external accountants, auditors and tax advisers, and strengthen accounting policies and controls as the company scales.

Financial Performance and Cash Management

Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, financial modelling and variance analysis. Challenge assumptions and translate financial results into clear recommendations for the CEO and department leaders.
Own a rolling 13-week cash-flow forecast and longer-term liquidity projections. Improve collections, working capital, spending discipline and visibility into financial commitments.
Analyze profitability by product, service and market. Use SaaS metrics, including ARR, retention, churn, gross margin, customer acquisition cost and payback, to evaluate performance and investment decisions.
Assess hiring plans, pricing, operating costs and major expenditures against expected returns. Drive measurable improvements in margins, productivity and progress toward sustainable profitability.

Talent Acquisition and Human Resources

Oversee talent acquisition and human resources, including internal staff and external providers. Align recruitment priorities and headcount plans with approved budgets and business needs.
Oversee recruitment execution, agency relationships, hiring timelines, onboarding and workforce planning. Hold hiring managers accountable for clear requirements, timely decisions and hiring outcomes.
Oversee HR administration, employee records, compensation and benefits coordination, performance-review processes, employee relations and offboarding, working with qualified advisers where required.

Vendor Negotiations and Corporate Infrastructure

Lead vendor negotiations and oversee procurement, contracts and renewals. Secure commercially sound pricing, payment terms and service commitments, and hold providers accountable for delivery.
Oversee corporate infrastructure, including offices, facilities, equipment, business systems and outsourced services. Ensure these resources support reliable daily operations and future growth.
Work with technology leaders on corporate IT providers, software licences, infrastructure spending and business continuity arrangements. Improve utilization and eliminate unnecessary or duplicate costs.

Operating Performance and Team Leadership

Establish operating KPIs, management dashboards and regular performance reviews across finance and the functions under your oversight.
Improve workflows, approval processes and reporting through practical automation and stronger data quality. Ensure corrective actions have accountable owners and deadlines.
Lead and develop the finance team and collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product and Technology leaders to improve execution and resource allocation.

Mandatory Qualifications

CPA designation in good standing in Canada.

At least 10 years of progressive finance experience, including hands-on leadership across financial reporting, controllership, budgeting, forecasting, cash management and operating performance.
At least three years of hands-on experience in a fast-paced SaaS business, including leadership of finance and operations for a PE-backed SaaS company scaling ARR from $5 million to $50 million.

Strong financial acumen and commercial judgment: the ability to interrogate financial results, build credible forecasts, evaluate SaaS unit economics and make sound decisions on costs, headcount and investment.
Proven experience directly supervising a Controller and accounting staff, reviewing their work and maintaining high standards for financial accuracy, control and delivery.
Direct experience overseeing talent acquisition, human resources, vendor negotiations and corporate infrastructure, with accountability for operational results.
Advanced financial modelling and Excel or Google Sheets skills, proficiency with accounting and reporting systems, and the ability to explain financial issues clearly to business leaders.
A record of personal ownership and effective execution in an environment with rapidly changing priorities, tight deadlines and limited resources. You must be willing to work on-site in Mississauga five days per week.

Additional Experience We Value

Measurable success improving profitability, cash generation or progress toward break-even.
Experience managing multiple entities, currencies or international operations.
Experience in healthcare technology or a business combining SaaS subscriptions and services.
Experience implementing finance systems, automating reporting or supporting transaction readiness.

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary:
CAD $135,000–$150,000 annually.
Annual target performance bonus:
50% of base salary, based on achievement of agreed performance objectives.
Total target compensation:
CAD $202,500–$225,000 annually.
Performance objectives will reflect measurable outcomes in profitability, cash management, financial reporting and operational execution.
Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage.
Paid vacation and free on-site parking.
An opportunity to work closely with the CEO and senior leadership and make a measurable contribution to a growing global healthcare technology business.

How to Apply

Submit your résumé with a brief summary of your experience in high-growth software or technology-enabled companies, including two or three measurable financial or operational results you personally delivered.
Shortlisted candidates should be prepared to discuss their experience with financial oversight, operational leadership, strategic planning, and board reporting. CPA credentials, employment experience, and professional references will be verified.

Accessibility Statement

BoomerangFX is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals and are dedicated to accommodating people with disabilities. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process, please contact recruitment@boomerangfx.com.
